texts.preamble: Sudarshan Jain vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 October, 2023 Author: Sunita Yadav Bench: Sunita Yadav
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner argued that the Courts below have wrongly appreciated the evidence and convicted the petitioner. It is further argued that there are material omissions and contradictions in the statement of prosecution witnesses. He was on bail during trial and never misused the [LEAKAGE_MASK] to him. He is suffering from Neurological problem. Hence, it has been prayed that the petitioner may be released on bail. On the other hand, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the application and prayed for rejection of the same.
